SELECT exam.id, exam_name, paper.name as paperName, start_time, duration, exam.status, exam.creator_id AS creatorId, exam.create_time, exam.update_time FROM exam left join paper on exam.paper_id = paper.id
${ew.customSqlSegment} AND exam.deleted = 0
AND exam.status = 1 AND #{now} < exam.start_time
AND exam.status = 1 AND #{now} >= exam.start_time AND #{now} <= DATE_ADD(exam.start_time, INTERVAL exam.duration MINUTE)
AND exam.status = 1 AND #{now} > DATE_ADD(exam.start_time, INTERVAL exam.duration MINUTE)
AND exam.status = #{viewStatus.code}
ORDER BY exam.update_time DESC
